summary: The pipeline produced high-quality documentation: 183/183 file blocks complete, 99% source coverage, functional module names, correct Mermaid graph, and proper marker formatting throughout. The single failure is R5b — per-module file block coverage: advanced_middleware (33/162=20%), body_updates (16/57=28%), main (24/197=12%) are all below the 80% threshold because the agent grouped multiple similar tutorial files under single <!-- file: --> markers instead of creating individual blocks. The overall source_file_coverage_percent is 99% (state.json) because submit_analysis counts files in source_files_covered, not file blocks — but the Appendix G file block metric fails for 3 modules. The root cause is a Skill doc ambiguity: phase3-detail.md says 'For EACH file, execute Steps 1+2' but never explicitly prohibits file grouping. Fix: add one sentence to phase3-detail.md explicitly requiring one file block per source file.
